statements.status_notes: The DHI bison APK backports the upstream fix from https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/bison.git/commit/?id=8d101c19d4d9aaedf83a448c925513742d4efcf0 as dhi-cve-2026-56390-output-paths.patch, which rejects %header and %output paths containing slashes so attacker-supplied grammar files cannot direct generated output to arbitrary writable locations. Tracker: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-56390

The DHI bison APK backports the upstream fix from https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/bison.git/commit/?id=3169c1e7a2c6acc4c59dfcf8b089896d6881925b as dhi-cve-2026-56389-xsltproc-path.patch, which always invokes xsltproc from PATH and drops grammar-controlled %define tool.xsltproc overrides during HTML report generation. Tracker: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-56389
